[P2] Stop accepted executions without worker evidence

An accepted invocation can remain queued or never write its first event. This cleanup set then omits it, and `load_markers()` filters the service's running-execution list using that same incomplete set. Consequently, `close_case()` never stops the execution, which can exhaust settlement's drain budget and block reuse of the shared fixture. Include outstanding test executions discovered through the service or invocation records independently of worker evidence, and cover an accepted execution with an empty event prefix.
